Container.Name: Oneirodex
Container.Overview:
Oneirodex stable release __VERSION__. The self-hosted game library for a household. Scan folders of DRM-free games and ROMs, identify them against IGDB / Steam / GOG, invite the family, download, play in the browser where a system supports it, and chat.
Everything runs in this one container, PostgreSQL included: no second database container to set up. Point "Games" at your games share (read-only), keep "Appdata" on the cache, and open the WebUI. The first visit runs the setup wizard.
Use Oneirodex only with software you are authorised to share. It ships no BIOS or firmware and no pirate tooling.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, generated secrets, logs, themes, covers and uploads. Keep this on the cache / an SSD and include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: Your games / ROMs share. Mounted read-only: Oneirodex only scans it.

Config.Name: Extra scan location 2
Config.Description: Optional second read-only scan location. Also add it to ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_ROOTS, e.g. NAS ROMs=/storage2

Config.Name: ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_ROOTS
Config.Description: Extra scan locations as the container sees them: Name=/storage2|Other=/storage3

Config.Name: ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_DIR
Config.Description: Persistent location for covers, themes, generated artwork and uploads.

Config.Name: Enable AI artwork
Config.Description: Optional cover generation through a private Stable Diffusion API endpoint on your LAN.

Config.Name: AI artwork API URL
Config.Description: Optional workstation Forge / AUTOMATIC1111 API URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7860. Keep it on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: AI artwork engine
Config.Description: Compatible API mode for Forge or AUTOMATIC1111.

Config.Name: Enable malware scanning
Config.Description: Optional ClamAV scanning. Enable after attaching this container and a ClamAV sidecar to the same private Docker network.

Config.Name: ClamAV host
Config.Description: Private Docker DNS name of the optional ClamAV sidecar.

Config.Name: ClamAV port
Config.Description: ClamAV TCP port on the private Docker network.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the embedded database runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the embedded database runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Leave empty: a strong key is generated on first start and kept in Appdata/secrets. Set it only if you already have one.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Leave false for plain http on your LAN. Set true when you reach Oneirodex through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
